title: Native launch logs "atomic job creation refused" for an ordinary CreateProcess failure and retries it through the fallback
outcome: windows_launch distinguishes a refusal of the atomic job attribute from an ordinary CreateProcessW failure (for example ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND or ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND for an absent program). Only a genuine job-attribute refusal logs "atomic job creation refused" and takes the suspended-assignment fallback. Other errors are returned as they are, without a second launch attempt.
acceptance: Launching an absent program through the native launcher returns its spawn error after one CreateProcessW attempt and logs no 'atomic job creation refused' line; a focused test covers it.
A genuine atomic-attribute refusal (the existing force_atomic_refusal seam) still takes the fresh-lease fallback, and its regression stays green.
The full gate is green and an independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
